Normal is the existing compatibility base label. Target jewellery has its own five-step ladder; item levels, equip requirements, quantities and costs remain E01 decisions.

materials.notes: Jewellery uses Tinkering. GoldRing art/name does not force Gold material; native default is Iron.
Wooden weapons/shields change maker from native Carpentry to Bowcraft/Fletching. Carpenter furniture remains separate.

materials.notes: Native CraftResource.None on cloth is not missing provenance. Remove bandage creation in T07. No new conversion weight policy here.

materials.source: native creature bones; exact production acquisition verified with the recipe cohort
materials.notes: Bone armour is heavy Tailoring. Native BoneChest combines leather and bones, reports MaterialType.Bone but DefaultResource.RegularLeather; Resource alone cannot classify it. No bone scrap or salvage-yield rule is invented.
